articles.title: Standard Chartered debuts tokenized deposits in Hong Kong for corporate clients
articles.snippet: The bank uses Hong Kong's EnsembleTX system to move deposits between participating banks around the clock, settling in central bank money.

articles.title: XRP Ledger set to fix flaw that could have let stablecoin partners print new tokens
articles.snippet: The fix is on track for Wednesday after validator support briefly dipped and restarted the two-week activation clock. XRP itself is unaffected.

articles.title: Metals.io issues tokens backed by 25 tonnes of physical copper stored in Germany
articles.snippet: The company is starting with $366,000 worth of copper stored in Germany, hoping to build a market for investors to own and trade physical metal onchain.

articles.title: Coinbase hit with 50% price target cut as post-earnings rout deepens
articles.snippet: Slowing trading activity and fallout from the Binance hack are clouding Coinbase’s revenue prospects, prompting Morgan Stanley to lower its rating on the stock.

articles.title: Binance hackers begin swapping stolen Solana tokens for Bitcoin: Chainalysis
articles.snippet: Crypto exchange Gate said it froze two linked accounts as US investigators urged platforms to block transactions tied to the $6.3 billion theft.
